LandingPage.heroSubtitle: Your AI coach turns a locked-in track, school or startup, into a daily plan, real deadlines, and a future you can actually see.

FeaturesSection.title: One plan. Built around what you're actually doing.
FeaturesSection.subtitle: Alxioum tracks the real details of school or your business, then turns them into a daily plan, an AI Coach that knows your context, and a long-term roadmap you can watch move. Two tracks, one app: you pick yours once, at signup, and everything below is built around it.
FeaturesSection.aiCoachTitle: A coach that actually knows what's on your plate
FeaturesSection.aiCoachDescription: Ask about a subject, your career options, or what to do today, and the Coach answers using your real homework, exams, and career match, not generic advice. Keeps full conversation history across as many threads as you want, and (for students) always keeps school first.
FeaturesSection.founderSubtitle: Everything above, rebuilt for a business instead of a transcript
FeaturesSection.founderPaused: The founder track is currently paused for new signups while we polish it. Here's what it already builds:
FeaturesSection.ctaTitle: Pick your track. We'll build around it.
FeaturesSection.ctaSubtitle: Alxioum is a planning and study tool that helps you stay organized and explore your options. It's not a guarantee of grades, a job, or a business outcome.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.description: Add your classes once and see today's schedule every morning, room numbers included.

homeworkTracking.title: Homework tracking
homeworkTracking.description: Every assignment with a real due-date countdown, so nothing quietly goes overdue.

examsReadiness.title: Exams & readiness
examsReadiness.description: A live countdown per exam, plus an honest readiness % built from how you're actually doing on that subject's topics.

weeklyStudyPlan.title: Weekly study plan
weeklyStudyPlan.description: A real Monday-Friday plan, session by session, that you check off as you go.

aiStudyPlans.title: AI study plans
aiStudyPlans.description: Generate a study plan for a specific subject or topic instead of guessing where to start.

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.description: Spaced-repetition flashcards that resurface exactly when you're about to forget them, not on a random schedule.

aiQuizzes.title: AI-generated quizzes
aiQuizzes.description: Pick a subject, a difficulty (Easy through Exam Level), and a question count to get a real quiz, not a static bank.

weakTopics.title: Weak topics
weakTopics.description: The topics you're actually struggling with, surfaced plainly with your real attempt history, no vague advice.

careerMatches.title: Career matches
careerMatches.description: Career suggestions matched to the subjects, interests, and strengths you gave at onboarding, each with a real % match.

futureMap.title: Future Map (roadmap)
futureMap.description: A 6-level Discover → Learn → Build → Launch → Grow roadmap. The first steps advance automatically from what you actually do in the app; later ones you mark done yourself, honestly.

weeklyReview.title: Weekly review
weeklyReview.description: A real weekly recap: study time, quiz accuracy, topics mastered, and how your week actually went.

xpStreaks.title: XP, streaks & achievements
xpStreaks.description: Real actions earn real XP and unlock achievements, not filler gamification.

milestoneTracking.title: Milestone tracking
milestoneTracking.description: Your idea, its stage (Idea → Validating → Building → Launched), and a milestone checklist you actually complete.

aiBusinessSnapshot.title: AI business snapshot
aiBusinessSnapshot.description: A short AI-written snapshot of your idea, generated from what you tell it at onboarding.

metricsLog.title: Metrics log
metricsLog.description: Log revenue, customers, or signups over time and see the trend versus your last entry.

expenseTracking.title: Expense tracking
expenseTracking.description: Log spend by category (software, marketing, contractors, and more) and see your running total.

aiContentHelper.title: AI content helper
aiContentHelper.description: Generate a first draft of Instagram, blog, or email content for a topic you give it.

competitorTracker.title: Competitor tracker
competitorTracker.description: Keep a running list of who else is in your market, with notes.

freePlan.q: Is there really a free plan?
freePlan.a: Yes. Core organization (timetable, homework, exams, career matches, or your business plan and milestones) is always free. AI features like the Coach, study plans, and quiz generation are part of Plus.

trial.a: Every new account gets a 3-day free trial of Plus automatically, no card required. When it ends, AI features pause until you subscribe, your core tracking (timetable, homework, exams, or your business plan) stays free either way.

billingInterval.q: Can I switch between monthly and yearly?
billingInterval.a: Yes, before you subscribe you can toggle between monthly and yearly anytime, right on this page or in-app. If you're already on Plus, switching intervals is done from the billing portal (Manage subscription).

switchTracks.a: Your track (student or founder) is locked in once you finish onboarding, so the app can build itself fully around it. If you signed up on the wrong track, contact us and we can help. Note: the founder track is currently paused for new signups while we polish it, so new accounts are on the student track for now.

AboutSection.title: Built for the two groups everyone else designs around.
AboutSection.intro: Most productivity apps are built for people who already have their life figured out: a stable job, a clear five-year plan, deadlines set by someone else. {name} is built for two groups who don't have that yet, students still building their transcript and their sense of what's next, and early founders still building a business with no one telling them what to do next either.
AboutSection.whyOneApp: We didn't want a generic to-do list with a school skin and a business skin bolted on. So {name} asks you, once, at signup: are you building a transcript or a business? Whichever you pick locks in and the entire app (your Home, your daily plan, your AI Coach's context, your long-term roadmap) is built around that answer from day one. No mode-switching, no half-built middle ground. (The founder track is currently paused for new signups while we finish polishing it; see our <faqLink>FAQ</faqLink> for details.)
AboutSection.belief1: No tracking, no ads. {name} doesn't run behavioral-advertising tracking or third-party ad pixels. The only cookie in play is the one that keeps you signed in. See our Privacy Policy for the specifics.
AboutSection.belief2: Honesty over gamification. Some parts of your roadmap you can only advance by telling us you actually did the real-world thing. We can't verify you launched a project or shipped a business milestone, so we don't pretend to. You mark it done because you did it, not because the app tricked you into a streak.
AboutSection.belief3: This is a planning tool, not a promise. {name} helps you organize your school work or your business and explore your options with AI support. It doesn't guarantee your grades, a job, or a business outcome. Any AI-generated content (study plans, quizzes, business drafts) is a starting point, not a substitute for your teacher, your own judgment, or a qualified professional.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information {name} collects, how it is used, and the choices you have about it. It applies to the {name} web app and any related services we operate.
PrivacyPage.whoWeAreBody: {name} is operated by [COMPANY NAME]. If you have a question about this policy or your data, contact us at [CONTACT EMAIL]. Our registered address is [ADDRESS].
PrivacyPage.infoCollectIntro: When you create an account, we collect the information you give us directly:
PrivacyPage.infoCollectAccount: Account information: your name and email address.
PrivacyPage.infoCollectOnboarding: Onboarding information: whether you're using {name} as a student or a founder, and the details that go with that (school/year group and subjects, or your business idea/stage).
PrivacyPage.infoCollectContent: Content you create in the app: homework, exams and timetable entries, study materials and notes, flashcards and quiz results, business plans and milestones, and messages you send to the AI Coach.
PrivacyPage.infoCollectBilling: Billing information: handled by our payment processor, Stripe (see below). We do not store your card details ourselves.
PrivacyPage.noAdTrackers: We do not use third-party advertising trackers, and we do not run persistent behavioral-advertising tracking of any kind on {name}. See the cookie notice at the bottom of every page for the specific cookies we use.
PrivacyPage.howWeUseIntro: We use the information above to:
PrivacyPage.howWeUseCore: Provide the core product: your dashboard, plan, study tools, and progress tracking.
PrivacyPage.howWeUseAi: Power AI features (the AI Coach, study-plan generation, quiz generation, and similar tools).
PrivacyPage.howWeUseBilling: Process payments and manage your subscription.
PrivacyPage.howWeUseComms: Communicate with you about your account (e.g. sign-in confirmation, important account notices).
PrivacyPage.howWeUseSecurity: Keep the app secure and diagnose problems when something breaks.
PrivacyPage.whereStoredBody: Your account data and everything you create in the app is stored using Supabase, our database and authentication provider, on infrastructure located in the United States. By using {name}, you understand your data will be processed and stored in the United States, which may have different data protection laws than your own country.
PrivacyPage.aiProcessingBody: Some features of {name}, including the AI Coach and AI-generated study plans, quizzes, and research, work by sending relevant information (such as your question, subjects, or study materials) to Anthropic, our AI provider, to generate a response using their Claude models. Anthropic processes this information to return a result to {name}; we do not control Anthropic's own data-handling practices, and we encourage you to review Anthropic's own privacy policy for details on how they handle data submitted to their API. Do not paste sensitive personal information into AI features that you would not want processed by a third-party AI provider.
PrivacyPage.paymentsBody: Subscription payments are processed by Stripe. When you subscribe to {name} Plus, your payment details are collected and processed directly by Stripe under Stripe's own privacy policy. {name} never receives or stores your full card number.
PrivacyPage.noSellTitle: We do not sell your data
PrivacyPage.noSellBody: We do not sell your personal data to third parties, and we do not share your homework, business, or conversation content with anyone except the service providers named in this policy (Supabase, Anthropic, Stripe), each of whom processes it only to provide their part of the service to us.
PrivacyPage.choicesBody: You can review and correct most of your account information from within the app. Self-service account deletion is being added to {name}; until it ships, you can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by emailing [CONTACT EMAIL], and we will action it in a reasonable timeframe.
PrivacyPage.minorsBody: {name} is used by students, some of whom may be under 18. We do not run behavioral-advertising tracking or public leaderboards, and we do not knowingly sell any user's data, minor or otherwise. If you are a parent or guardian and want to review, correct, or request deletion of your child's data, contact us at [CONTACT EMAIL] and we will work with you directly.
PrivacyPage.changesBody: We may update this policy as {name} changes. We'll update the “draft last updated” date above when we do. Material changes will be communicated in-app or by email where practical.
PrivacyPage.questionsLine: Questions about this policy or your data? Contact us at [CONTACT EMAIL].

TermsPage.title: Terms of Service
TermsPage.intro: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your use of {name}, operated by [COMPANY NAME]. By creating an account or using {name}, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use {name}.
TermsPage.accountBody1: You need an account to use {name}. You're responsible for keeping your login details secure and for all activity that happens under your account. Tell us at [CONTACT EMAIL] if you think your account has been accessed without your permission.
TermsPage.accountBody2: When you sign up, you choose a track (student or founder) and complete a short onboarding flow. Note: the founder track is currently paused for new signups while we polish it, so new accounts are on the student track for now. Your track is locked once onboarding is complete so the app can build itself around it correctly; if you signed up on the wrong track, contact us and we'll help.
TermsPage.usingIntro: You agree to use {name} only for its intended purpose: organizing your schoolwork or your business plan, and using the tools we provide to support that. You agree not to:
TermsPage.usingRule1: Use the app to store or share content that is illegal, harmful, or infringes someone else's rights.

TermsPage.usingRule3: Attempt to disrupt, reverse-engineer, or abuse the app or the AI features (for example, using them for purposes unrelated to your studies or business, or in ways designed to bypass usage limits).
TermsPage.usingRule4: Resell or provide commercial access to {name} to others without our permission.
TermsPage.usingSuspend: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.
TermsPage.contentBody: You own the content you create in {name} (your homework, notes, business plans, and similar material). You grant us a limited license to store, process, and display that content back to you, and to send relevant parts of it to our AI provider, Stripe, and Supabase, solely to operate the app for you. See our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink> for details.
TermsPage.aiFeaturesBody: {name}'s AI features (the AI Coach, generated study plans, quizzes, and research tools) use a third-party AI model to generate responses. AI-generated content can be incomplete or inaccurate. It is provided to help you study or plan, not as a substitute for your teacher, school, professional accountant, lawyer, or other qualified advisor, and you should use your own judgment before relying on it, especially for graded work or business decisions.
TermsPage.billingBody: Core organizational features of {name} are free. Some features (including AI tools) require a paid {name} Plus subscription, billed through Stripe on the interval you select at checkout. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel. You can manage or cancel your subscription from within the app at any time; cancelling stops future renewals but does not automatically refund the current billing period unless required by law.
TermsPage.endingBody: You can stop using {name} at any time. Self-service account deletion is being added to the app; until it ships, you can request deletion of your account at any time by emailing [CONTACT EMAIL]. We may also suspend or close accounts that violate these Terms.
TermsPage.disclaimersBody: {name} is provided “as is.” We work to keep it accurate and available, but we do not guarantee it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that AI-generated content will always be correct. To the fullest extent permitted by law, [COMPANY NAME] is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of {name}.

hint.label: Hint

explain.unframed: Help me understand the concept behind this homework.

example.label: Show Similar Example

example.unframed: Show me a similar worked example for this kind of homework so I can figure mine out.

walkthrough.label: Walk Me Through It
walkthrough.framed: Here's what I'm stuck on: "{question}". Walk me through it step by step. Ask me what I already know before telling me the next step. Don't just give me the final answer.
walkthrough.unframed: Walk me through this homework step by step. Ask me what I already know before telling me the next step. Don't just give me the final answer.

school-30min-revision.title: Complete 30 minutes of focused revision
school-30min-revision.description: Pick your weakest topic from School and revise it with no distractions for 30 minutes.

school-past-paper.title: Complete one past-paper question set
school-past-paper.description: Find a past paper or practice set for an upcoming exam and complete it under timed conditions.

school-summarise-topic.title: Summarise a topic in your own words
school-summarise-topic.description: Turn one lesson's notes into a one-page summary you could teach to a friend.

skill-coding-concept.title: Learn a new coding concept
skill-coding-concept.description: Watch or read one short lesson on a coding concept you don't know yet, then write 5 lines using it.

skill-public-speaking.title: Practice explaining an idea out loud
skill-public-speaking.description: Record a 60-second voice memo explaining something you learned this week, as if teaching someone else.

skill-design-basics.title: Learn one design principle
skill-design-basics.description: Look up one design principle (e.g. contrast, hierarchy) and find 3 examples of it in apps you use.

career-research.title: Research a career in depth
career-research.description: Pick one career match and research a typical day, salary range, and required education.

career-shadow-conversation.title: Talk to someone in a career you're curious about
career-shadow-conversation.description: Ask a parent, teacher, or family friend about their job: what they actually do day to day.

career-linkedin-explore.title: Explore 3 real job postings
career-linkedin-explore.description: Look up 3 real job listings in a field you're interested in and note the skills they ask for.

business-find-problems.title: Find 5 problems customers have
business-find-problems.description: Talk to or observe people around you and write down 5 real problems they complain about.

business-one-pager.title: Write a one-page business idea
business-one-pager.description: Pick one problem you found and write a one-page plan: who has it, and how you'd solve it.

business-pitch-practice.title: Pitch your idea to someone
business-pitch-practice.description: Explain your idea out loud to a friend or family member in under 2 minutes and get their honest reaction.

creative-portfolio-piece.title: Create your first portfolio piece
creative-portfolio-piece.description: Make one small creative piece (design, video, writing, or code) you'd be proud to show someone.

creative-short-video.title: Film and edit a short video
creative-short-video.description: Plan, film, and edit a video under 60 seconds on a topic you care about.

creative-study-inspiration.title: Study 3 creators or designers you admire
creative-study-inspiration.description: Break down what makes 3 pieces of creative work (channels, designs, brands) effective.

1.title: Discover your interests
1.description: Complete onboarding and explore your top career matches.

2.title: Learn the basics
2.description: Build one core skill your top career needs: coding, design, writing, or numbers.

3.title: Build your first project
3.description: Turn what you're learning into something real you can show.

4.title: Launch it
4.description: Share your project or idea with a real audience, even a small one.

5.title: Get your first users or feedback
5.description: Get real feedback from people outside your immediate circle.

6.title: Build something bigger
6.description: Turn an early win into a bigger project, portfolio, or small business.

software-engineer.name: Software Engineer
software-engineer.tagline: Build the apps and systems people use every day.
software-engineer.whyItMatches: You're drawn to technology and problem solving, and you like building things that actually work.
projects: Build a personal website
Build a simple to-do app
Create an AI chatbot
tryNow: Try a free intro-to-Python tutorial
Rebuild a simple website you like
Join a beginner coding community

entrepreneur.name: Entrepreneur
entrepreneur.tagline: Spot real problems and build something that solves them.
entrepreneur.whyItMatches: You're interested in business and money, and you like the idea of building something of your own.
projects: Run a small online shop
Sell a service to 3 real customers
Write a one-page business plan
tryNow: Find 3 problems people around you actually complain about
Interview a local small business owner
Read one book on starting a business
educationRoutes: Start while still in school, learn by doing

ai-engineer.name: AI Engineer
ai-engineer.tagline: Design and train the models behind modern AI products.
ai-engineer.whyItMatches: You're curious about AI and enjoy math and computer science, the two subjects that matter most here.
projects: Train a simple image classifier
Build a chatbot with an AI API
Analyse a public dataset
tryNow: Play with a free AI playground tool
Watch an intro-to-machine-learning video
Learn basic Python if you haven't yet

data-scientist.name: Data Scientist
data-scientist.tagline: Turn messy data into decisions people actually act on.
data-scientist.whyItMatches: You like maths and problem solving, and you're interested in how data drives technology and business.
projects: Analyse a dataset and present 3 findings
Build a simple dashboard
Predict something from public data
tryNow: Explore a free public dataset
Try a beginner spreadsheet data-analysis exercise
Learn basic statistics

digital-creator.name: Digital Creator
digital-creator.tagline: Build an audience and tell stories people want to watch.
digital-creator.whyItMatches: You enjoy content creation and social media, and you like expressing ideas creatively.
projects: Post 5 short videos on one topic
Design a simple brand for your channel
Edit a 60-second highlight reel
tryNow: Film one short video this week
Learn a free video-editing tool
Study 3 creators you admire and note what works
educationRoutes: No formal requirement, built through practice

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.tagline: Diagnose, treat, and care for people through science.
doctor.whyItMatches: You're interested in medicine and science, and you like working with and helping people.
projects: Volunteer or shadow in a healthcare setting (age-appropriate)
Research one area of medicine in depth
Present a health-science topic to your class
tryNow: Read about a medical breakthrough
Ask your school about work-experience options
Strengthen your Biology and Chemistry foundations

lawyer.name: Lawyer
lawyer.tagline: Argue, negotiate, and use the law to solve real disputes.
lawyer.whyItMatches: You're interested in law, and you're strong at communication and structured argument.
projects: Join a debate or mock-trial club
Write a persuasive essay on a real issue
Research how a real case was decided
tryNow: Watch or read about a real court case
Join your school debate club
Practice writing a persuasive argument
educationRoutes: Work experience at a law firm

product-designer.name: Product Designer
product-designer.tagline: Design the look and feel of the products people use.
product-designer.whyItMatches: You're interested in design and creativity, and you like making things that look and feel good to use.
projects: Redesign an app screen you use daily
Design a logo and mini brand kit
Create a simple prototype in a free design tool
tryNow: Try a free design tool for an hour
Study the design of 3 apps you use
Sketch 5 icon ideas for a made-up app

mechanical-engineer.name: Mechanical Engineer
mechanical-engineer.tagline: Design and build the machines and systems that power the world.
mechanical-engineer.whyItMatches: You're interested in engineering, and you like understanding how things work and building them.
projects: Build a small mechanical model
Take something apart and rebuild it
Enter a school engineering/robotics challenge
tryNow: Watch how a real machine works and sketch the parts
Try a free beginner CAD tool
Build something with your hands this week

finance-analyst.name: Finance Analyst
finance-analyst.tagline: Understand money, markets, and how businesses make decisions.
finance-analyst.whyItMatches: You're interested in money and business, and you're comfortable with numbers.
projects: Track and analyse a mock investment portfolio
Build a simple budget spreadsheet
Research how a real company makes money
tryNow: Read one beginner-friendly finance article a week
Learn how compound interest works
Try a free budgeting spreadsheet template
educationRoutes: Internship at a bank or firm

sports-professional.name: Sports Professional
sports-professional.tagline: Turn discipline and performance into a career in sport.
sports-professional.whyItMatches: You're interested in sport, and you already put in the discipline it takes to compete and improve.
projects: Build a structured 4-week training plan
Track your performance stats over a season
Join a competitive league or trial
tryNow: Set one measurable fitness goal for this month
Ask a coach for honest feedback
Study the training routine of a pro in your sport
